records.translation: Volver a dibujar lo que cambió un Apply de Preferences, y nada más.

records.label: spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.refresh_after_preferences#1
records.source: THE APPLY THAT CHANGED ONE SLIDER REBUILT HOME. Page opacity is in the window's signature, so moving it ran :meth:`refresh_theme` -- Home rebuilt (2.1-2.6 s on a loaded box), the tree retranslated (0.3 s), every alpha gate walked -- while the only things on Home that had taken the opacity were three rules, which :meth:`HomePage.refresh_pane_surfaces` sets again in place.
records.context: The apply that changed one slider rebuilt home. Page opacity is in the window's signature, so moving it ran :meth:`refresh_theme` -- Home rebuilt (2.1-2.6 s on a loaded box), the tree retranslated (0.3 s), every alpha data-selection boundary walked -- while the only things on Home that had taken the opacity were three rules, which :meth:`HomePage.refresh_pane_surfaces` sets again in place.
records.translation: EL APPLY QUE CAMBIÓ UN DESLIZADOR RECONSTRUÍA HOME. La opacidad de la página está en la firma de la ventana, así que moverla ejecutaba :meth:`refresh_theme` -- Home reconstruida (2.1-2.6 s en un equipo cargado), el árbol retraducido (0.3 s), cada puerta alfa recorrida -- cuando lo único en Home que había tomado la opacidad eran tres reglas, que :meth:`HomePage.refresh_pane_surfaces` vuelve a fijar en su sitio.

records.source: Preferences' Apply and its Revert: a new sheet is put on the windows one per pass of the event loop, after the next paint (:func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window`), and the icon sizes are re-derived only when a scale changed.

records.translation: Aplicar y Revertir de Preferences: se pone una hoja nueva en las ventanas, una por pasada del bucle de eventos, tras el siguiente dibujado (:func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window`), y los tamaños de icono se vuelven a derivar solo cuando cambió una escala.

records.label: spacr.qt.theme.apply_stylesheet_per_window#6
records.source: put the sheet on nothing now: the windows on show get it one per pass of the event loop, after the next paint, and the hidden ones after them (:func:`_sheet_the_windows_in_slices`). A window that polishes or shows before its turn is sheeted then, as any window is. Preferences' Apply asks for this.
records.context: put the sheet on nothing now: the windows on show get it one per pass of the event loop, after the next paint, and the hidden ones after them (:func:`_sheet_the_windows_in_slices`). A window that polishes or shows before its turn is sheeted then, as any window is. Preferences' Apply asks for this.
records.translation: no poner la hoja en nada ahora: las ventanas que se muestran la reciben una por pasada del bucle de eventos, tras el siguiente dibujado, y las ocultas después de ellas (:func:`_sheet_the_windows_in_slices`). Una ventana que se pule o se muestra antes de su turno recibe la hoja entonces, como cualquier ventana. Apply de Preferences lo pide.

records.context: Give the masthead, the panels and the tabs the page opacity now set.
records.translation: Dar a la cabecera, a los paneles y a las pestañas la opacidad de página ahora establecida.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.HomePage.refresh_pane_surfaces#1
records.source: They took it when Home was built, and a new opacity used to rebuild Home: 2.1-2.6 s of the GUI thread on a loaded box, for three kinds of rule. Each is now set again in place, one widget per pass of the event loop, and only where the rule changed, since setting a rule restyles everything under it.
records.context: They took it when Home was built, and a new opacity used to rebuild Home: 2.1-2.6 s of the main GUI execution path on a loaded box, for three kinds of rule. Each is now set again in place, one widget per pass of the event loop, and only where the rule changed, since setting a rule restyles everything under it.
records.translation: La tomaron cuando se construyó Home, y una opacidad nueva solía reconstruir Home: 2.1-2.6 s del hilo de la GUI en un equipo cargado, para tres tipos de regla. Cada una se vuelve a fijar ahora en su sitio, un widget por pasada del bucle de eventos, y solo donde la regla cambió, ya que fijar una regla vuelve a aplicar estilo a todo lo que hay debajo.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.HomePage.refresh_pane_surfaces#2
records.source: THE TABS ARE TOLD ON THEIR BAR. The tab widget's rule holds the whole of Home under it, and setting it again restyled every tile (1.1 s loaded) to change one tab's fill; the bar takes the selected tab's fill as a rule of its own, which wins over the one it inherits.
records.context: The tabs are told on their bar. The tab widget's rule holds the whole of Home under it, and setting it again restyled every tile (1.1 s loaded) to change one tab's fill; the bar takes the selected tab's fill as a rule of its own, which wins over the one it inherits.
records.translation: A LAS PESTAÑAS SE LES DICE EN SU BARRA. La regla del widget de pestañas contiene todo Home bajo ella, y fijarla de nuevo volvía a dar estilo a cada baldosa (1.1 s con carga) para cambiar el relleno de una pestaña; la barra toma el relleno de la pestaña seleccionada como una regla propia, que prevalece sobre la que hereda.
